question: What practice concerning the soul has been told to the addressee, and to whom is it addressed?
premises: This practice of the soul has been told to her.
The statement affirms that it has been told.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
